releases.body:
## OpenCode Lookout 0.1.3

### Changed

- Publish through the manual trusted-publishing workflow with OIDC provenance,
  the first release after the approved v0.1.2 bootstrap.
- Complete npm package metadata: keywords, author, and tests for repository,
  homepage, bugs, license, engines, and the packed README/source. Show the npm
  version badge and refresh the README install instructions for the published package.
- No runtime behavior changes.

### Approval and validation

Approved revision `26f1359209807017d5abd85389bee93794c45896` (merge of PR #10). Post-merge CI and full push CodeQL passed on this revision. This is the first release intended for the OIDC trusted-publishing workflow with npm provenance.

### npm

Published from the manual **Publish npm (manual)** workflow after the `npm` environment approval.

releases.name: OpenCode Lookout 0.1.2
releases.body:
## OpenCode Lookout 0.1.2

### Changes

- Add an allowlisted npm package and `lookout` executable with independent offline
  recovery from a dedicated, stable installation prefix.
- Precompile the Solid TUI for installed-package loading; use optional host-provided
  SDK/UI peers instead of a duplicate SDK dependency graph.
- Audit and test the production-installed package, including exact-tarball Docker
  compatibility, cancellation, confirmed controls and recovery.
- Add a manually approved trusted-publishing workflow for future npm versions.
- Correct the terminal harness's post-cancellation assertion for changed-cell
  redraws without changing runtime behavior or safety checks.

Existing plugin/RPC IDs, `/lookout`, storage keys, ownership markers and recovery
commands are preserved. v0.1.1 and its signed tag are unchanged.

### Approved revision and artifact

The maintainer explicitly approved `753213b51fae8e08f7d2069f4b76bfc131b1cb74`
for merge and the signed v0.1.2 GitHub/npm release, conditional on all release gates.
PR #9 records this approval and the first-package bootstrap exception.

- Approved source SHA-256: `23faa5cc0f4f8c410004415359b8b5ff6c44d7b76a513a44168b43daa3092193`
- Tested tarball: `opencode-lookout-0.1.2.tgz`
- SHA-512 integrity: `sha512-NByAWYHvtfZ5BilMUiaN05y64mLQX/P3VEkKHpq3MhRP9Ue0aPJORWkckcItFI8awjUugCTxittSFpdZUJ3rGA==`

### Validation

43 tests, formatting, documentation, lint, types, generated-source equality,
production-install recovery and consumer audit pass. All configured security
checks pass without findings at any severity. The candidate's full push CodeQL
passes both languages. Docker tests cover the newest five stable OpenCode CLIs,
2.2.2–2.2.6, in wide/default and narrow/tokyonight modes; no next RC was discovered.
Local Linux arm64 and hosted Linux amd64 matrices pass. Node 22/24 runtime checks
and Node 26 quality checks pass. Post-merge CI
[`42446241891`](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/actions/runs/42446241891)
and full push CodeQL
[`42446241874`](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/actions/runs/42446241874)
pass on main commit `0a9afff6cf5111eabf6671d312217b901ad9bf33`, whose source tree
is identical to the approved candidate.

### npm publication and installation

GitHub release publication is separate from npm availability. The approved
first-package bootstrap publishes the exact tested v0.1.2 tarball with the
maintainer's authenticated npm session and private 2FA. **This version has no
GitHub OIDC provenance.** Future versions will use trusted publishing after
package setup. npm delivery is not complete until registry integrity and a fresh
consumer installation have been verified.

After npm publication, follow the [stable-prefix installation instructions](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/blob/v0.1.2/README.md#install).
Direct registry plugin entries and ephemeral npm-exec caches are not owned by the
offline recovery CLI. Use the installed `lookout` executable for `status`,
`unload`, or `restore --yes`. Before switching from a checkout, restore restrictions
and unload with the old checkout's CLI. No personal installation is migrated.

OpenCode 2.2.2 uses the tested read-only profile; 2.2.3+ supports controls.
The offline CLI supports Node 22+. PTY tests are not pixel-level/accessibility
audits, provider authentication tests, or security guarantees. See
[validation](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/blob/v0.1.2/docs/VALIDATION.md)
and the [threat model](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/blob/v0.1.2/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md).


### npm publication record

Published `opencode-lookout@0.1.2` on 2026-11-09T02:14:34Z using the approved
first-package bootstrap (maintainer-authenticated, private 2FA). Registry `latest`
points to 0.1.2, and its SHA-512 integrity matches the tested artifact:

releases.name: OpenCode Lookout 0.1.1
releases.body:
# OpenCode Lookout 0.1.1

Corrective GitHub source release. This supersedes v0.1.0, which was returned to draft after its post-merge full CodeQL scan reported a fixture-only finding omitted by PR analysis. The v0.1.0 signed tag is retained unchanged.

## Corrections

- Remove an unused temporary dump of the isolated test server's session response. Terminal tests now assert that no response dump is saved.
- Run full CodeQL on candidate branch pushes. Required `Analyze` checks are distinct from change-focused `PR Analyze` checks; a clean PR scan cannot substitute for full-candidate assurance.
- Require post-merge full checks and an identical approved source tree before publication. No finding suppression or severity waiver was added.
- Runtime plugin behavior and production dependencies are unchanged from v0.1.0.

## Features and compatibility

Lookout provides searchable resource inventory, details and pins, file-sourced plugin descriptions, confirmed exact-ID local controls, and independent offline recovery. Status styling uses native semantic colors; MCP browsing remains native to OpenCode.

The breaking rename uses `opencode-lookout`, `/lookout`, `bin/lookout.mjs`, and `lookout:` ownership markers, without legacy aliases. Before replacing an older installation, use its own recovery CLI to inspect and restore its owned restrictions and unload it. Do not run both copies. The new CLI does not remove old ownership blocks. See the [README](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/blob/v0.1.1/README.md) and [changelog](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md).

- OpenCode 2.2.1–2.2.2: verified read-only inventory, rejected mutations, offline lifecycle, and both terminal browsing modes.
- OpenCode 2.2.3–2.2.5: verified effective skill/MCP/plugin restrictions, recovery, and both terminal modes.
- All ten cases pass on local Linux arm64 and hosted Linux amd64. No next-release RC was available during discovery.
- Development requires Node 26.4.0+ and npm 11+. The production-only offline CLI retains Node 22+ support; hosted runtime checks use npm 11.19.1 and Node 22/24.

## Validation and approval

Approved/tagged revision: `e5e19a93daa635c04df252f9cb3f6acace6b786c`.

Source SHA-256: `d4cab949320a754741f22b3fe8013265cfc7c6ce222b8064483a3c9e93c5798b`.

- All 37 tests, formatting, docs, lint, and type checks pass.
- npm audit/signatures, Semgrep, full-history/current-source Gitleaks, Trivy, and full CodeQL pass without configured findings or errors.
- [Candidate CI](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/actions/runs/42145845042) and [full push-event CodeQL](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/actions/runs/42145795478) pass. Exact-revision maintainer approval is recorded in [PR #7](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/pull/7).
- Before publication, all eight full post-merge checks passed on `2dd58c9d34069f419f77ff24a7e980f0df783ffb`: [main CI](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/actions/runs/42228702649), [main CodeQL](https://github.com/sodejm/opencode-lookout/actions/runs/42228702681). Its source tree matches the approved tagged candidate exactly. No open CodeQL or Dependabot alerts remained at publication.

## Limits

Clean configured scans are not a security guarantee. Terminal tests are not pixel-level or accessibility audits; provider authentication, quota, remote-server behavior, and other terminal sizes are not certified. Controls affect global configuration and do not revoke content already loaded into conversations.

This is a GitHub source release, not an npm publication. `private: true` remains enabled. No personal configuration, credentials, raw logs, or retained fixtures are attached. MIT licensed; not an official OpenCode product.
